Hi Marcelo,

fieldMask minimally requires RGB data because the indices used for soil masking contain at least some of those channels. See the list of indices in Indicies.txt (https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR/blob/master/inst/extdata/Indices.txt)

Best,
Noah

You can work with it now if you want to try. The only difference will be that the zip file is called FIELDimageR-fix-missing-elide-fx.zip

Best,
Noah
